title: Slide and Drift
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about momentum. Every step Kit takes adds to his speed instead of moving him, so he gets faster while a key is held and glides on after he lets go. A wall stops him at once. In the second level, a hop made at speed carries across gaps a standing hop cannot. Nothing here hurts. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two levels to cross, and every step adds to his speed. Hold a key and he gets faster, let go and he glides on, press the other way and he slows. In the second level a run-up carries a hop across wide gaps. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Momentum is one setting on a sequence in the character file
Made to be copied and taken apart
